We ensure a secure, clean and trusted website environment for you and your visitors. *Secure Today. Safe Tomorrow.* --- ## Best For * Business Websites * eCommerce Stores * Blogs & News Websites * Portfolio Websites * Membership Sites * Educational Websites * Non-Profit Organizations * Any Type of Website ## What You'll Get * **Malware Scanning & Removal:** We scan and remove malware, viruses, trojans and suspicious files. * **Vulnerability Detection:** Identify and fix security loopholes before hackers can exploit them. * **Firewall Protection:** Advanced firewall to block malicious traffic and attacks. * **Login & Access Security:** Secure login, strong passwords, 2FA and brute-force protection. * **File Integrity Monitoring:** We monitor core files and detect unauthorized changes. * **Database Security:** Secure and clean database to prevent SQL injections. * **Regular Backups:** Daily backups of website files and database. * **Security Hardening:** We harden your website, CMS, plugins and server. * **Blacklist Monitoring:** We monitor and remove your site from blacklists (if any). * **Security Reports:** Detailed security reports and recommendations. ## Key Benefits * **Protects From Hackers:** Keeps your website safe from brute force attacks and hacking attempts. * **Prevents Data Loss:** Regular backups ensure your data is always safe and recoverable. * **Builds Visitor Trust:** A secure website builds trust and credibility with your visitors. * **Avoids Downtime:** Prevent attacks and infections that can cause downtime. * **Improves SEO:** Secure websites rank higher on search engines. * **Peace of Mind:** We handle security, so you can focus on growing your business. --- ## Our Security Protection Process 1. **Security Audit:** We perform a full security audit of your website. 2. **Malware Scan:** We scan all files and database for threats. 3. **Threat Removal:** We clean malware, viruses and suspicious codes. 4. **Vulnerability Fix:** We fix all security and compliance loopholes. 5. **Security Hardening:** We harden your website, server and CMS. 6. **Backup Setup:** We setup automated daily backups for safety. 7. **Monitoring & Report:** We monitor 24/7 and provide regular security reports. *We follow industry best practices and use advanced security techniques to keep your website clean, secure and always protected.* --- ##
